hand_ur.note: club.glb origin (grip) and orientation: club head along +Y when the socket has no rotation

hand_ul.note: left upper hand: palm centre (mirror of the right grip) in the hand_u_l frame, world-up orientation. NOT on the club: for the left hand on the club (two-hand slam) use club_grip2 as the IK target

forearm_ur.note: weak point `forearm`: middle of the right upper forearm, radius ~0.33 m

head.note: the eye (front of the head), for look-at / targeting

club_grip2.note: second grip on the club handle, 0.7 m above the main grip along the club axis, in the hand_u_r frame (moves with the club); same orientation as the club (+Y = club axis)

walk.speed_note: planted-foot speed at playback 1.0 (walk_n animator, ak solve every frame: 2.54 m/s, 1.48 m per 0.58 s stance; GLB re-measure in Godot see docs/notes/assemble2_cyclops.md). cyclops.gd plays walk at ground speed / move_speed (walk_speed 2.6 -> 1.02x)
walk.events_note: integrate2_cyclops 2026-11-23: one footfall event per foot at the measured heel contacts of the natural walk (GLB, lowest foot vertex reaches the floor: right 0.4167 s = frame 10, left 1.125 s = frame 27 at 24 fps); replaces the single `step` 0.40 (+ half the clip). cyclops.gd thuds on every event named step*.

size.note: rest pose (T upper arms, club held up in hand_u_r); GLB includes the club mesh (node "club", child of joint hand_u_r)
